issues.problem: Context about few people studying abroad fit 寥寥无几 (cy198) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it as '全村考上大学的人屈指可数，他就是其中之一', which stresses that the few can be named one by one.

issues.problem: Misuse '时间供不应求' is a playful stretch that some native speakers do say, so it is not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced it with a grammar misuse that gives the idiom an object ('工厂供不应求客户的订单').

issues.problem: Context '形形色色的走私手段' fit 五花八门 (cy051) equally well or better, since that one is about odd variety of methods.
issues.action: Replaced it with a context about a show's guests of every kind of person.

issues.problem: Context '两家火锅店各有千秋，我都喜欢' could also take 不相上下 (cy196).
issues.action: Added the two different strengths (broth vs. meat) so only 'each good in its own way' fits.

issues.problem: Register was 'written', but the expression is common in educated speech and the card already has a spoken dialogue context.
Two contexts repeated the cue's situation (a deputy succeeding a retiring leader), and two shared the same 既然…就顺理成章 shape.
issues.action: Rewrote the deputy context (ten years in China leads to heading the China office) and the premises context (从这些数据出发，得出这个结论是顺理成章的).

issues.problem: None. Story checked against 《孟子·告子上》 (犹以一杯水救一车薪之火也；不熄，则谓之水不胜火) and it is accurate.
